question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Enrage
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Infuriate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Enrage"** means to make someone very angry. (क्रोधित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **His rude comments were enough to enrage everyone in the room.
 
 
 
• **"Infuriate" **means to make someone extremely angry. (क्रोध दिलाना)
 
 
• **Example: **Her dismissive attitude infuriated her colleagues.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Infuriate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Expand **(विस्तार करना): To increase in size, number, or importance.
 
 
• **Example:** The company plans to expand its operations overseas.
 
 
 
• **Eradicate **(समाप्त करना): To destroy or get rid of something completely.
 
 
• **Example: **Efforts are being made to eradicate polio worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Stimulate** (प्रेरित करना): To encourage or cause something to happen or develop.
 
 
• **Example:** The government introduced measures to stimulate economic growth.
